privacy.ai_training_note: Square's AI Terms of Service explicitly grant Square a broad license to use customer AI Content 'to provide, promote, incorporate into, train, fine-tune, test, evaluate and develop the AI Products.' No opt-out mechanism exists. The ToS states: 'IF YOU DO NOT WISH TO GRANT SQUARE A LICENSE TO ANY OF YOUR AI CONTENT, PLEASE DO NOT USE SQUARE'S AI PRODUCTS.' This applies only to Square AI Products, not to core payment/POS features. Outputs may persist in historical or cached copies indefinitely.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region: United States, United Kingdom, EU, Australia, Japan. No data residency lock-in; global transfers permitted to affiliates and subprocessors.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Industry-standard SSL/TLS. Symmetric keys minimum 128 bits; asymmetric keys minimum 2048 bits. Only standard, well-reviewed cryptographic protocols and message formats (SSL, PGP) used.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Sensitive data encrypted using industry-standard methods when stored on disk. Full data encryption within card reader at moment of swipe.

security.name: Zero Trust Architecture
security.value: Listed as an active control in Trust Center.

security.value: Active program listed in Trust Center Application Security controls.

security.name: Penetration Testing

security.name: DDoS Protection
security.value: DDoS Protection listed in Network Security controls.

security.name: Endpoint Protection and MDM
security.value: Endpoint Protection and Mobile Device Management (MDM) listed in controls.

security.name: Incident Response

security.name: Background Checks

products.name: Square Point of Sale

products.notes: PCI DSS 4.0.1 compliant; merchants do not need separate PCI validation. Hardware includes Reader, Terminal, Stand, Register, Handheld.

products.name: Square Payments
products.data_scope: Payment card data, transaction history, payout data

products.name: Square Banking (Checking/Savings)
products.data_scope: Banking transactions, account balances, financial data
products.notes: FDIC pass-through insurance via Sutton Bank. Issued by Square Financial Services, Inc., a Block, Inc. subsidiary. Not FDIC-insured bank itself.

products.name: Square Payroll
products.data_scope: Employee PII, salary/wage data, tax records
products.notes: Subject to payroll-specific terms. Sensitive employee data processed.

products.name: Square Appointments

products.notes: HIPAA BAA available and applies to Appointments for eligible healthcare providers.

products.notes: Trains on customer AI Content. No opt-out. Governed by separate AI Terms of Service. ISO 42001 not held.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium core POS with transaction-based fees; subscription tiers for advanced features (Plus, Premium); hardware sold separately or via installment plans
compare.data_residency: No lock-in; US-primary with EU/UK/AU/JP processing; Standard Contractual Clauses for EU transfers

flags: Square's AI Terms explicitly grant Square a broad license to train on customer AI Content with no opt-out mechanism. Businesses that do not wish to grant this license must forgo all Square AI Products.
The HIPAA BAA explicitly excludes Square Buyer Services (consumer-facing features). Organizations handling PHI must verify each specific product is covered before use.

The Trust Center (trust.squareup.com) is powered by Vendict, and some reports (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 certificate) require account access to download. The public-facing overview is accessible without login.

There is no contractual data residency lock-in; data may be processed globally. EU users are protected via SCCs with the Irish DPA as lead supervisory authority, but no dedicated EU-only data region option is publicly documented.
